name: Venomancer: Slimy Stingers puddles every enemy struck by Carapace Crash rank 58 (#5378)
contract: #5378 reports Slimy Stingers only affecting one enemy, not all enemies in 8yd, when Carapace Crash hits a group. This is the same mechanism as #5548 (Fixes in c84e5aa3b, already on origin/main): Slimy Stingers (706001) procs Beetle Slime (704347) per struck target via AscensionVenomancerEvents.cpp's Check() `damage && Named(info,803199)` and Proc() `player->CastSpell(target,704347,true)` (the Unit* overload, required because 704347's EffectImplicitTargetA[0]=53=TARGET_DEST_TARGET_ENEMY resolves its destination from the spell's unit target). The original #5548 scenario proved this at level 60 casting 803199 literally. #5378's reporter is level 59, so their learned ability is rank 573063 (level 58 per AscensionSpellProgressionData.h:2302), not the literal 803199 anchor. `Named(info,803199)` resolves via `sSpellMgr->GetFirstSpellInChain`, which is DB-driven; rev_20260903_01_live_class_baseline.sql:1934-1942 inserts spell_ranks rows linking 803199 (rank 1) through 573063 (rank 9), so GetFirstSpellInChain(573063) should equal GetFirstSpellInChain(803199) and the already-fixed per-target Beetle Slime cast should apply identically to rank 573063. This scenario reproduces #5378's exact setup (Carapace Crash rank 573063, two dummies within the 8yd/5yd AoE radius) to confirm the already-merged fix covers this rank too.
